capabilities: Browse an expandable folder tree and per-folder notes lists in a sidebar
Create smart folders from rules on tags, properties, names, paths, and dates
Group root folders into named collapsible sections
Reorder, nest, and un-nest folders by drag and drop
Pin notes through the core Bookmarks plugin
extras: Tested only on macOS, iOS, and iPadOS; drag-to-reorder is desktop-only. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later. Does not search note contents or rename/delete notes. Listing notes it does not edit vault content, but dragging folders does move folders in the vault.
intentEvidence: a compact alternative to the built-in File Explorer
problem: Obsidian's built-in File Explorer is a plain folder tree; users who want a compact folder-plus-notes-list browsing layout, like Apple Notes, have no native option.

relations.evidence: Alternative Explorer was inspired by Apple Notes and Notebook Navigator
Alternative Explorer was inspired by Apple Notes and Notebook Navigator

summary: Apple Notes–style sidebar that browses folders and notes, with smart folders, sections, and drag-to-reorder, as an alternative to the built-in File Explorer.
